:::{#def-nonconstructive-proof}
#### Non-constructive proof

A **non-constructive proof**
[@wikipedia_constructive_proof]
of a [proposition](#def-proposition) $\exists x \in S,\ P(x)$
shows that it is true
without naming any element $x$ of $S$
for which $P(x)$ is true.
It is a [proof](#def-proof) that is not a [constructive proof](#def-constructive-proof).

:::
